subject: Lake Superior

claims.text: Lake Superior has a surface area of 31,700 square miles (82,000 km²), which is approximately the size of South Carolina or Austria.
It is the largest freshwater lake in the world by surface area.

Lake Superior straddles the Canada–United States border, with the Canadian province of Ontario to the north and east and the U.S. states of Minnesota to the west and Michigan and Wisconsin to the south.
The total area of Austria is 83,871 km².
